Estimated items on the tray:
- Sourdough toast slice, large: ~110 g, about 280 kcal (P 9, C 52, F 3)
- Egg and ham muffin or English muffin sandwich: ~250 kcal (P 13, C 24, F 11)
- Banana, medium: ~105 kcal (P 1, C 27, F 0)
- Blueberry muffin: ~380 kcal (P 5, C 50, F 17)
- Milky tea or coffee: ~40 kcal (P 2, C 3, F 2)
- Butter portion: ~35 kcal (F 4)
- Vegemite portion: ~10 kcal (P 1, C 1)

Served total: 280 + 250 + 105 + 380 + 40 + 35 + 10 = 1100 kcal.

Leftover is unknown before eating, so I assume a typical amount: part of the muffin, the banana skin (already excluded from the banana figure), and some of the toast. I estimate about 150 kcal left over.

Eaten: 1100 − 150 = 950 kcal.

- Protein: ~28 g
- Carbohydrate: ~135 g
- Fat: ~32 g
